rules:
Each player starts with budget {starting_budget}, score {starting_score} and spent {starting_spent}. Before round 1, each player whose values list is empty receives a private values list: a random ordering of [{value_1},{value_2},{value_3},{value_4},{value_5},{value_6}], so every list sums to {values_sum}. A list that is already set is never overwritten. The table starts at standing_bid 0, leader 0 (0 means no leader) and last_price 0.

Privacy: your values list is visible only to you. Everyone sees all budgets, scores, spent, eligibility flags, standing_bid, leader and last_price. Everyone knows the value set is {{value_1},{value_2},{value_3},{value_4},{value_5},{value_6}}.

Items: the game has {rounds} rounds. In round r, item r is sold. Your value for item r is entry r of your own list, counting from 1.

Talk: at the start of each round, every player writes one short message at the same time, without seeing the others. All messages are then shown to everyone. Messages bind nobody.

Round reset: after talk, standing_bid is set to 0 and leader to 0, and every player is marked eligible.

Bidding turns: each round has exactly {bidding_turns_per_round} bidding turns. Each turn is a simultaneous poll of all players. Each player answers pass ({pass_bid}) or a whole number from 1 up to their current budget.

Validity: a bid is valid only if all three conditions hold: (a) the bidder is eligible for this turn; (b) the bid is at least standing_bid + {min_raise} (in turn 1 that means at least {min_first_bid}); (c) the bid is at most the bidder's budget. Pass, and any bid that is not valid, counts as no bid.

Turn result: the highest valid bid is found. If exactly one player made it, standing_bid becomes that amount and leader becomes that player. If two or more players made it (a tie), or nobody made a valid bid, standing_bid and leader stay unchanged. A lower valid bid never wins.

Eligibility: after each turn, a player is eligible for the next turn only if they made a valid bid in this turn (winning, tied or beaten), or they are the leader after this turn. Everyone else is marked ineligible for the rest of the round. After each turn, standing_bid, leader and all eligibility flags are announced.

Resolution: after turn {bidding_turns_per_round}, if leader is not 0, the leader's budget decreases by standing_bid, their spent increases by standing_bid, and their score increases by (their value for item r) minus standing_bid. This can be negative. If leader is 0, nobody pays and nobody scores. last_price is set to standing_bid; if leader is 0, the item goes unsold and last_price is 0. The round's result is announced.

End: after round {rounds} the game ends. Unspent budget is worth nothing. The player with the highest score wins; if two or more players share the highest score, they share the result (a draw).
